title: Full Rank and Stable Sampling of $\tanh$ Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the recovery of feedforward $\tanh$ networks of fixed architecture with $P$ parameters from finitely many point evaluations. First, we characterize the set of parameters where the differential of the realization map has full rank and show that it coincides with the regular parameters in the sense of Vla{\v{c}}i{\'c} and B{\"o}lcskei (2021). Second, we make use of this characterization to prove that almost every tuple of $2P+1$ sampling points yields uniform-norm Lipschitz stability on compact subsets of this parameter set. Third, we prove that for exact observations, projected gradient descent and projected Gauss--Newton converge locally from sufficiently close feasible initial guesses. The same evaluations also determine the realized function for arbitrary parameters and identify parameters in the characterized set up to permutations and sign changes of hidden neurons. translated_title: tanh 网络的满秩与稳定采样
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有固定架构、含 $P$ 个参数的前馈 $\tanh$ 网络从有限个点采样值中的恢复问题。首先，我们刻画了实现映射的微分具有满秩的参数集合，并证明该集合与 Vlačić 和 Bölcskei (2021) 意义下的正则参数相重合。其次，我们利用这一刻画证明：几乎任意一组 $2P+1$ 个采样点都能在该参数集的紧子集上产生一致范数意义下的 Lipschitz 稳定性。第三，我们证明对于精确观测，投影梯度下降法和投影 Gauss–Newton 法从足够接近的可行初始点出发可局部收敛。同样的采样值还能确定任意参数下所实现的函数，并在允许隐藏神经元的置换与符号变化的前提下识别出被刻画参数集中的参数。最后，我们针对实解析（函数）开发了一个一般性框架。
tldr: 本文刻画了 tanh 网络中实现映射微分为满秩的参数集（与正则参数一致），并证明几乎任意 2P+1 个采样点即可保证一致范数 Lipschitz 稳定采样、参数可识别性（允许隐藏神经元置换与符号变化），以及投影梯度下降与投影 Gauss–Newton 方法的局部收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the parameter set where the differential of a tanh network's realization map has full rank (coinciding with regular parameters), and proves that almost any 2P+1 sampling points guarantee uniform-norm Lipschitz stability, identifiability up to hidden-neuron permutations and sign changes, and local convergence of projected gradient descent and projected Gauss–Newton methods.
